thread:
Maria K: Heads-up — SDK v2.3 lands tomorrow morning. Two small but important changes: header normalization for auth and a change to streaming retry semantics. If you have custom auth middleware or rely on the old streaming ondata ordering please read below.

Devon T: Quick Q — what exactly changed for auth headers?

Maria K: Previously the client accepted either `authorization` or `x-auth-token` headers. v2.3 normalizes and enforces `Authorization: Bearer <token>` only. We did this to avoid accidental double-sends and to match other infra. If you set tokens via middleware, update to explicitly set `authorization`.

Devon T: Example change?

Maria K: Sure — Node example:
```js
// old (might have accepted x-auth-token)
const token = req.headers['x-auth-token'] || req.headers['authorization'];
// new (explicit)
req.headers['authorization'] = `Bearer ${token}`;
```

Kevin L: Python note — the python client still accepts token via constructor `Client(api_key=...)` and will send the right header; only concern is teams that manually mutate headers before client send.

Samira J: Streaming behavior — what changed there? We saw duplicated ondata events in our chat worker after upgrading beta.

Maria K: Good catch. v2.3 introduces an internal retry layer for streaming connections. By default it attempts one short reconnect on transient socket closes. That avoids full request retries but can cause duplicate finalization events if your consumer doesn't dedupe.

Samira J: How to opt out?

Maria K: For Node: pass `{streamRetries: 0}` in the client options or set env `RW_STREAM_RETRY=0`. For Python: `Client(stream_retries=0)`. Example:
```js
// Node
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_API_KEY, streamRetries: 0 });
```

Devon T: Is this opt-out per-request or global? We want global off for a while.

Kevin L: It's a per-client setting today (so global for a process). We're adding a per-request override in a patch if needed.

CI Bot: build/pr-1248 — SDK v2.3 release candidate passed smoke tests :white_check_mark: (logs: https://ci.internal/runs/1248)

Alexa P: Heads-up for integrators: v2.3 also deprecates `client.oldStreamHandler()` — use `client.stream()` with the new event API. Deprecation window is 3 months; a console warning will be emitted.

Samira J: Thanks — we'll schedule a quick spike tomorrow to flip client options in staging. Anyone encountered issues with the Node websocket lib after enabling streamRetries?

Kevin L: One team saw a race where their code called `stream.cancel()` in `ondata` and that could race with the reconnect. Workaround: debounce cancel or set `streamRetries: 0` until we ship v2.3.1 with proper cancel handshake.

Devon T: Ok — I'll ping product to add a small blurb to the upgrade notes and a migration snippet for express middleware. :+1:

Maria K: Awesome. If you need targeted help, drop the failing trace here or tag me. Planning to cut the release at 06:00 UTC tomorrow.

Alexa P: FYI I'll add the deprecation entry to the changelog and the console warn text.

Samira J: I'll spin a canary in staging at 07:00 UTC and report back. :eyes:
